metaDescription: A private, multilingual daily planner for tasks, routines, and personal organization.
focusSub: Move your three most important tasks forward, the rest can wait.
autoBackupRestoreConfirm: I understand that current tasks, routines and settings will be replaced by this backup. Changes made after this backup will be lost.

backupDirectoryUnsupported: Folder selection is unavailable in this browser. Use Download backup to save a JSON file.

storageSaveError: Your changes could not be saved. Please try again.
installAppHelp: Open your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen.
autoBackupNoneYet: No automatic backup has been created yet.
autoBackupStatusFailed: Could not read the latest backup status.
autoBackupRunFailed: The automatic backup failed. Your previous saved backups remain available.
storageRecoveryDescription: Previously saved data could not be found. Select your JSON backup to recover missing data.
autoBackupDescription: Creates one internal backup daily at the selected device-local time and keeps the latest seven copies. If the app is closed, a missed backup is created when it reopens, using the data available then. Downloaded JSON files are needed for recovery if browser data is deleted.
autoBackupSaveFailed: The backup schedule could not be saved.
backupReplaceWarning: Restoring replaces all current tasks and routines. If the file includes preferences, your language, calendar and appearance settings will also be restored. Download a backup of your current data first if you want to keep it.
backupReplaceConfirm: I understand and want to replace my current tasks and routines.
backupRecoverySummary: This file contains {tasks} tasks and {routines} routines.
backupRecoveryNotice: Only missing records are restored. Existing data is preserved. If an older backup has no preferences, missing preferences are recovered from this browser or application defaults.
backupInvalidFile: This backup is invalid, unsupported, or larger than 10 MB.
backupRestoreFailed: Recovery failed. Your data has not been partially restored. Please try again.
backupSettingsDescription: Download a JSON copy of your tasks and routines. Keep the file somewhere safe so you can recover missing data.
backupDownloadStarted: Download started: {tasks} tasks and {routines} routines. Check your Downloads folder.
backupDownloadFailed: The backup could not be created. Your saved data has not been changed.
